import sys

def main():
    N = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    if N == 1:
        print(2)
        print("1 1")
        return
    
    if N == 2:
        print(3)
        print("2 1 2")
        return
    
    if N == 3:
        print(4)
        print("2 1 3 2")
        return
    
    bombs_count = N + 1 if N % 2 == 1 else N + 2
    bombs = []
    
    mid = N // 2
    
    bombs.append(mid + 1)
    for i in range(mid, 0, -1):
        bombs.append(i)
    for i in range(N, mid, -1):
        bombs.append(i)
    if N % 2 == 1:
        bombs.append(mid + 1)
    
    print(bombs_count)
    print(' '.join(map(str, bombs)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
